name: Residence Permit for Guest Workers

requirements.blocker_text: Employer must be registered as a Strategic Government partner, an investor of outstanding national economic significance, an Outstanding Exporter Partnership Programme partner, or a licensed temporary work agency ('lender of labour force'). As of the source reviewed, Government Decree No. 450/2024 currently designates ZERO third countries whose nationals may be employed in Hungary under this permit category -- the legal mechanism exists in law but is not accessible to any nationality at present.

evidence_required.document: Employer registration proof (Strategic Partner / Exporter Programme / licensed agency)

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years initially, extendable by 1 additional year, maximum 3 years from first issuance

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- Residence Permit for Guest Workers: currently zero eligible third countries under Government Decree 450/2024, employer-type restrictions, explicit statutory bar on National Residence Card eligibility

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT NOT FOR SOURCING REASONS (the sole hard requirement is tier-1 sourced) BUT BECAUSE THE ROUTE IS CURRENTLY INACCESSIBLE TO ANY NATIONALITY: the source states plainly that no third countries are currently designated under Government Decree 450/2024. This is included for completeness / to document the legal mechanism, not because anyone can practically use it today -- a future decree could reopen it to specific countries. Family reunification is explicitly prohibited (birth-in-Hungary exception only), and the source explicitly states holders 'may not be granted a national residence card' -- i.e. this route has no statutory path to Hungary's own permanent-residence status by design.
